Name: Auto Treasure Collector
Author: daitsuku
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]
Auto Treasure Collector is a lightweight Stardew Valley mod that automatically collects treasure from fishing treasure chests. If you've ever found the comprehensive [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25996][b]Glory Of Efficiency[/b][/url] mod a bit overwhelming and only wanted the auto treasure collection feature, this mod is perfect for you!

[line]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic Treasure Collection:[/b] No need to manually collect treasure after fishing.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory Protection:[/b] If your inventory is full, the chest stays open with the leftovers safe inside — nothing is ever lost.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-language:[/b] English, Japanese, Spanish, Chinese and Thai translations included.[/*]
[*][b]Customizable Options:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable or disable the mod as needed.[/*]
[*]Play a sound when treasure is collected.[/*]
[*]Display a notification when items are added to your inventory.[/*]
[*]Set a collection delay (0 ms for instant collection).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Lightweight and Efficient:[/b] Focused solely on treasure collection without unnecessary extras.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu:[/b] If installed, you can adjust settings conveniently in-game.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install SMAPI[/b]: Stardew Valley's modding API.[/*]
[*][b]Download the Mod[/b]: Place the [b]AutoTreasureCollector [/b]folder into your [b]Mods [/b]folder.[/*]
[*][b]Optional[/b]: Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game configuration.
[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Configuration[/b]
In the [b]config.json[/b]
or through the Generic Mod Config Menu, you can adjust:

[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Toggle the mod on or off.[/*]
[*][b]Play Sound:[/b] Enable sound effects when treasure is collected.[/*]
[*][b]Show Notification:[/b] Display a HUD message when treasure is added.[/*]
[*][b]Collection Delay:[/b] Set the delay time (in milliseconds) before the treasure is collected.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Works well with other fishing related mods.[/*]
[*]No known conflicts.[/*]
[/list][line]
[quote]This mod was inspired by the auto treasure collection feature in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25996][b]Glory Of Efficiency[/b][/url] but aims to provide a simpler, standalone solution.[/quote]
